title: 第21章 九劫雷煌体恨火铸魔身第22章 玄天泣血幡卷苍生
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
紫金炼狱，焚魔化道！
镇魔剑令所化的熔炉内部，如同宇宙初开的毁灭核心。
亿万柄燃烧着紫金神焰的诛魔符文小剑，疯狂切割、穿刺、焚烧着被封印其中的万魂王剑幡与恨煞王剑道基！
那火焰非是凡火，而是蕴含天道诛魔意志的炼魔真炎，至阳至刚，专克阴邪煞气！
嗤嗤嗤——！
新生的万魂王剑幡剧烈震颤，暗金幡面上刚刚凝聚的王煞锁链纹路在炼魔真炎下发出刺耳的哀鸣，光芒迅速黯淡。
核心的万魂王煞剑魄疯狂旋转，漆黑的恨火竭力抵御，却如同冰雪遇骄阳，被紫金神焰不断蒸发、炼化！
反哺给阴九幽的力量变得灼热而充满毁灭性，不再是滋养，而是焚身的毒火！
阴九幽意识所化的恨煞王剑道基，更是首当其冲！
剑身之上暗金与恨火交织的纹路被烧得通红，发出痛苦的铮鸣！
炼魔真炎顺着道基与意识的连接，狠狠灼烧着他的神魂本源！
那是一种比煞海蚀魂更恐怖万倍的痛苦，仿佛灵魂被投入了锻造神兵的熔炉，每一寸都在被煅烧、锤打、剥离杂质！
“呃…啊——！”
无声的惨嚎在意识核心激荡。
恨煞王剑的剑尖甚至开始出现融化的迹象！
境界从金丹初期巅峰飞速跌落！
眼看就要道基崩毁，神魂俱灭！
清虚真人的意念化身悬浮于炼狱之外，冰冷的眼眸注视着剧烈震动、光芒明灭不定的紫金熔炉，嘴角勾起一丝掌控一切的弧度：
“负隅顽抗！
炼魔真炎之下，任你魔威滔天，也终将化为最精纯的诛魔之力，反哺我玄天剑宗镇魔剑令！”

然而，就在阴九幽的意识即将被炼魔真炎彻底焚灭，恨煞王剑道基也濒临崩溃的刹那——
“炼…吧…炼…吧！”
一个冰冷、疯狂、带着一种彻底毁灭与涅盘重生意念的声音，在炼狱核心响起！
阴九幽放弃了所有抵抗！
他不再试图保护道基，不再试图守护幡魂！
他将那被炼魔真炎灼烧到极致、压缩到极致的滔天恨意，连同濒临崩溃的恨煞王剑道基本身，以及万魂王剑幡传递来的所有痛苦、不甘、吞噬意志…
所有的一切，如同献祭的薪柴，疯狂地、决绝地…投入到了那被炼魔真炎压制到极限的万魂王煞剑魄核心之中！
“万魂…归…墟！
道…基…为…引！
恨…火…焚…天！
引…劫！
！”
随着这撕裂灵魂的咆哮！
嗡——！
被压制到极致的万魂王煞剑魄，如同被投入了亿万颗恒星的熔炉核心，轰然爆发出前所未有的漆黑光芒！
这光芒不再被紫金神焰压制，反而带着一种…
引动天地规则、亵渎天道意志的疯狂气息！
content_en:
Purgatory of Purple Gold, Demon Burning Way!
The inside of the furnace transformed by the Demon-Suppressing Sword Order is like the core of destruction at the beginning of the universe.
Billions of demon-slaying rune swords burning with purple-gold divine flames were frantically cutting, piercing, and burning the Ten Thousand Soul King Sword Banner and the Hate Evil King Sword Daoji that were sealed inside!
That flame is not an ordinary fire, but a demon-refining true flame that contains the will of heaven to slay demons. It is the most yang and the most strong, and is specially designed to defeat evil and evil spirits!
Chi chi chi——!
The reborn Ten Thousand Souls King Sword Flag trembled violently, and the newly condensed King Sha chain patterns on the surface of the dark gold flag let out a harsh whine under the true flames of demon refining, and the light quickly dimmed.
The core of the Ten Thousand Souls King's evil sword was spinning crazily, and the dark fire of hatred tried its best to resist, but it was like ice and snow meeting the scorching sun, being continuously evaporated and refined by the purple gold divine flame!
The power fed back to Yin Jiuyou became hot and destructive. It was no longer nourishment, but poisonous fire that burned the body!
The Hate Evil King Jian Daoji, who was transformed into Yin Jiuyou's consciousness, was the first to bear the brunt!
The lines of dark gold and hatred on the sword were burned red, making a painful clang!
The Demon Refining True Flame followed the connection between Daoji and consciousness, severely burning the origin of his soul!
It was a kind of pain that was thousands of times more terrifying than the evil sea eroding the soul. It was as if the soul had been thrown into a furnace for forging divine weapons, and every inch was being calcined, hammered, and stripped of impurities!
"Uh...ah——!"
A silent howl stirred in the core of his consciousness.
The tip of the Hateful King Sword even began to show signs of melting!
The realm has fallen rapidly from the peak of the early stage of Jindan!
The foundation of the road is about to collapse, and the spirit and soul will be destroyed!
The incarnation of Master Qingxu's thoughts was suspended outside purgatory. His cold eyes stared at the purple gold furnace that was shaking violently and the light flickered on and off. The corner of his mouth curled up with a hint of control:
"Resist tenaciously!
Under the true flame of demon refining, no matter how powerful your demon is, it will eventually turn into the purest demon-slaying power and feed back my Xuantian Sword Sect’s demon-suppressing sword order! "
However, at the moment when Yin Jiuyou's consciousness was about to be completely incinerated by the Demon Refining True Flame, and the Hate Evil King Sword Daoji was on the verge of collapse——
"Practice... let's practice... let's practice!"
A cold, crazy voice, with the idea of ​​complete destruction and nirvana and rebirth, sounded in the core of purgatory!
Yin Jiuyou gave up all resistance!
He no longer tries to protect Daoji, no longer tries to protect Banner Soul!
He combined the monstrous hatred that was burnt and compressed to the extreme by the Demonic Refining True Flame, together with the Hate Evil King Sword Daoji itself that was on the verge of collapse, and all the pain, unwillingness, and devouring will conveyed by the Ten Thousand Soul King's Sword Flag...
Everything, like sacrificial firewood, was thrown crazily and decisively into the core of the Ten Thousand Soul King's Sword Soul that was suppressed to the limit by the Demon Refining True Flame!
"All souls...return...to the ruins!"
Tao...basis...for...guidance!
Hate...fire...burn...the sky!
Causing... calamity!
! "
With this soul-rending roar!
Buzz—!
The Ten Thousand Soul King's Evil Sword Soul, which was suppressed to the extreme, was like being thrown into the core of the furnace of billions of stars, bursting out with an unprecedented pitch-black light!
This light is no longer suppressed by the Purple Gold Divine Flame, but instead carries a...
A crazy aura that triggers the rules of heaven and earth and blasphemes the will of heaven!
